summary: Approved exact current commit bcf7a8e37678923fbe787f4276e6e6485b78a0d9 with no blocking or non-blocking finding. The integrated diff satisfies every HARDEN-001 requirement and acceptance criterion: fixed non-interpolated policy is supplied only through GenerateContentConfig.system_instruction; user contents is exactly the fixed synthetic-data label plus canonical JSON; the combined UTF-8 byte ceiling permits one call at 128 KiB and makes zero calls above it; and the existing no-tools, zero-or-one-call, structured-output, evidence-validation, sanitized-failure, deterministic-fallback, timeout, output-token, response-size, candidate-authority, and local synthetic-only boundaries remain intact. Adversarial and independent acceptance tests inspect actual SDK arguments, including multibyte size accounting, instruction-like data, environment sentinels, and absent tool configuration. The Python 3.12 lock contains 70 unique exact pins and 973 SHA-256 artifact hashes, is reproducible from the documented pip-tools 7.5.0 command, installs with --require-hashes, and passes pip check. pip-audit 2.10.1 is directly pinned; the identical required strict hash-enforced no-ignore audit runs through normal verification, security-only verification, and CI without application credentials and reports no known vulnerabilities. All Python-installing workflows use the lock; direct-input/lock consistency and audit-error failure are independently covered. Reviewer reruns in the lock-installed Python 3.12 environment passed all 63 backend and agentic tests, pip check, dependency audit, project/task/OpenAPI validation, and diff hygiene. Runtime-generated OpenAPI was unchanged across the FastAPI/Starlette upgrade, and the authoritative contract, approved dataset, frontend, database, deterministic rules, public endpoint source, and product scope are unchanged from ada0f12. Commit-bound verification passed at 98c71aa2e0002998c451404e94c70399e8dc8fc9 and security approved e48894a49a6a2a2b5efa02fa0af0e848408da560; later commits contain only permitted verification/security reports and lifecycle status, so both evidence chains are current for this reviewed HEAD.
